title: F31: a dead_shell fast-fail should retry ONE fresh session of the same CLI family before the chain moves on
summary: F27 makes the fatal-pane fast-fail act (recovery.fatal_pane=enforce), so a dead claude-tmux pane leaves the wait in one interval instead of 900 s. But the exit-81 chain then walks to the next CLI family; with codex quota-walled (until 2026-10-14) and ollama unable to write source, cycle 1687's triage exhausted the chain anyway. dead_shell means the REPL process died, not that the CLI or account is unusable, so a fresh session of the same family would likely have succeeded.
fix: Key the remediation on the detector's TerminalCause: carry a typed terminal cause on the bridge response (not the exit-81 summary text), and in bridgechain.Walking give a session-recoverable cause (dead_shell) exactly one fresh-session attempt on the same CLI before advancing; model/config causes (model_invalid) advance as today. Pin with a fake dead pane then a live one.
notes: Architecture review of F27 (2026-09-26): keep it cause-keyed; reordering the chain is the weaker fix. Verified then that a fast-fail stop and the old reviewer pause enter the chain at the same rung (both ExitArtifactTimeout 81).
